components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Warm-ink primary action with a restrained institutional hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--color-ink, #171310); color: var(--color-on-primary, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2px; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ink-soft, #2e2a22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0b3d6b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Grounded secondary action separated by a strong one-pixel rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, #171310); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--color-canvas, #ffffff); color: var(--color-ink, #171310); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-canvas-soft, #f7f5f0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0b3d6b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: High-contrast structural field for public and authoring forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-ink, #171310); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, #171310); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--color-canvas, #ffffff); color: var(--color-body, #2e2a22); font: 400 17px/1.6 var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-body-muted, #5d5647); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0b3d6b); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
TCN should feel like a carefully edited institutional record: calm enough for sustained reading, formal without ceremony, and contemporary without looking like a software product. Georgia carries scholarship and narrative; Pretendard carries navigation, metadata, and authoring controls. Near-black ink, a single institutional blue, warm paper surfaces, and ruled divisions create hierarchy without decorative chrome.

The public site serves an international scholarly association and is intentionally English-first. Its large body type, strong contrast, generous line height, and broad touch targets support older readers without turning accessibility into a separate visual mode. The authoring interface uses the same type, color, and border vocabulary at a denser rhythm; danger colors belong to authoring state, not public branding.
keyCharacteristics: Serif narrative and sans-serif structure, with no webfont dependency for the serif voice.
Restrained palette: ink, paper, one institutional blue, plus danger feedback for failed states and form validation.
Flat surfaces separated by tone, whitespace, and one-pixel rules.
Desktop body copy at 18px/1.75, with 68ch as the standard reading measure and named 60–62ch and 74–76ch exceptions.
Primary controls at 48px; compact secondary controls respect a 44px touch-target floor.
Responsive behavior driven by real content thresholds at 576px, 640px, 768px, 896px, 1024px, and 1152px, several of which are component-local rather than global.

rules.name: The Record, Not Dashboard Rule
rules.body: Public pages must read as edited scholarship, never as a SaaS dashboard, marketing template, or collection of interchangeable cards.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second brand hue. Institutional blue is used for links, labels, active state, focus, and selection; its restraint is the identity.

rules.name: The Public Theme Boundary Rule
rules.body: Dark-mode guidance applies to public pages only until the admin layout gains its own theme bootstrap and control.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif carries scholarship and narrative. Sans-serif carries wayfinding, metadata, status, and controls. Never create a third display voice.

rules.name: The Honest Floor Rule
rules.body: New readable copy must use 14px or larger. Existing 11–13px labels are short, bold, and local; do not copy them into paragraphs, navigation, captions, or form help.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface is part of document flow, it stays flat. Shadows are reserved for layers that physically overlap other content.

rules.name: The Grounded Component Rule
rules.body: A component in document flow earns separation through spacing, tone, or a hairline. Do not turn every section, profile, or list item into a rounded card.

rules.name: Link Affordance by Context
rules.body: Persistent underlines are reserved for prose links, contact values, downloadable filenames, and literal URLs. Structured navigation, tables of contents, tabs, cards, buttons, and administrative actions use grouping, hover surfaces, focus rings, and current-state indicators instead of resting text underlines.

dos: Do use Georgia at weight 600 for headings and Pretendard for navigation, metadata, and controls.
Do keep public narrative copy at 17–18px with generous line height and a 68ch reading measure, reserving 60–62ch for leads and 74–76ch for full academic documents.
Do reserve institutional blue for links, active state, labels, selection, and focus.
Do use 48px primary controls and preserve a 44px floor for compact secondary controls.
Do build responsive behavior around the actual 576px, 640px, 768px, 896px, 1024px, and 1152px thresholds, and keep the narrower ones scoped to the components that need them.
Do keep content visible without JavaScript and remove nonessential motion for reduced-motion users.
Do use paper tone, whitespace, and hairlines before introducing another container.
Do keep persistent underlines on prose links, contact values, downloadable filenames, and literal URLs so they remain identifiable without colour alone.
donts: Don't invent tokens or components that are absent from the codebase; primary, body-sans-strong, story-card, story-row, and officer-card are not part of the current system. There are no --spacing-* tokens either: spacing comes from Tailwind's numeric scale, so cite the actual utility or pixel value rather than a named step.
Don't introduce a second brand color, gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative background effects.
Don't use rounded cards as default scaffolding or combine a content-card border with a wide shadow.
Don't repeat tiny uppercase eyebrows above every section; use the established eyebrow only where its category signal materially helps navigation.
Don't treat 768px as the universal mobile/desktop boundary or assume every academic document has an aside.
Don't apply public dark-theme claims to admin pages until admin has an explicit theme mechanism.
Don't reuse the local 11–13px exceptions for readable copy, navigation, captions, or form help.
Don't add shadows to grounded surfaces; the overlay shadow belongs only to overlapping layers.
Don't use resting text underlines in structured navigation, tables of contents, tabs, cards, buttons, or administrative action controls.
